# EvolutionarySpikeOptimization

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The use of evolutionary algorithms to directly optimize spike-based network parameters, bypassing gradient signals entirely. Provides a biologically plausible and hardware-friendly alternative to gradient-based training for neuromorphic systems.
